This article is a stub. Mod International was a swim equipment dealer with addresses in
California, Vancouver and Quebec, which continued Cronus stopwatch sales in Canada after
[Seagull Enterprises](seagull.md) stopped in 1978.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
